notes: Worker Frens ART launch on Ethereum (chain id 1), independent of the collection launch. Deploy WorkerArt1 and WorkerArt2 (src/art/WorkerArt.sol, no arguments), then WorkerFrensRenderer (src/frens/WorkerFrensRenderer.sol) with the two chunks in that order. The data contracts hold the repository's unchanged art as STOP followed by PUSH32-framed data. The renderer reads these two chunks and the IMD swarm's FrenArtChunk1..7 already on Ethereum, checking each chunk's code hash on every read. Its nonpayable constructor checks the two new chunks' code hashes against WorkerArtIndex (BadArt on mismatch), calls nothing, and deploys on a fresh chain. None of these three contracts has an owner or any role. Deployment sends zero ETH and requires no initialization calls. test_EachLaunchFitsOneTransaction prices the art launch at about 13.6M gas all in, below EIP-7825's 2^24 cap with over 1M gas to spare. PlaceFrens and PlaceModules belong to the separate collection launch. After both launches, the team wallet runs script/frens/DeployFrens.s.sol setup() with MODULES set to that launch's PlaceModules and RENDERER set to this launch's confirmed WorkerFrensRenderer address. FrensPlacementForkTest with MAINNET_RPC_URL checks the renders against script/art/data/expected.json. Contract sources, art, deployment salts and build settings are unchanged.
